key_insight: For cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, suitably chosen large SGD learning rates can preserve convergence and achieve an accelerated O(T^-2) rate despite stochastic gradient noise.
engineering_relevance: The results motivate testing larger learning rates rather than treating classical curvature-based stability thresholds as absolute limits.
method: Characterize stochastic optimization trajectories under large learning rates.
Establish accelerated convergence for cross-entropy with linear and two-layer models.
Use sharper trajectory control to improve stable-regime convergence guarantees, including for deterministic optimization.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments demonstrate practical benefits of large learning rates, but the abstract provides no datasets, benchmark details, or effect sizes.
watch_item: The guarantees concern specific losses and model classes; arbitrary large learning rates or extensions to deeper networks are not established by the abstract.
paper_title: SGD with Large Learning Rates: General Analysis & Improved Rates
